reason: A recent regional conservation planning document was indexed, but no directly verified, durable conservation acreage divided by full Monterey County land area was retrieved. Regional-plan area cannot be used as the County denominator, and no acreage from a search snippet is accepted.
nearest_data: The Monterey County Regional Conservation Investment Strategy (2021) search result described protected lands within its regional planning area, which is not identical to Monterey County; https://www.montereycountyrcis.org/static/MontereyCountyRCIS_Final_Jun2021.pdf. This PDF was not opened and no figure from its search result is used. The County GIS and California Protected Area Database were considered, but no verified county-area calculation was completed.
